_meta.how: PUT /api/v1/projects/1/tasks against the reference server, then read the row back with sqlite3 and the object back through GET /api/v1/tasks/{id}

storage.note: the engine runs with SetTZDatabase(GMT), so stored values are UTC with no offset suffix

zero.note: an unset time is SQL NULL and comes back as Go's zero time, never as JSON null

round_trips.note: sub-second precision is discarded on write
